species.note: Phusis as emergence and unfolding. A rose is the only plant named; the fern is the pairing.

firstLine: In the age of the first and definitive unfolding of Western philosophy among the Greeks, when questioning about beings as such and as a whole received its true inception, beings were called phusis. …
